# Data Retention and Privacy

- Public snapshots: retain current plus sufficient accepted history for rollback and audit; define a business-approved duration.
- Private source evidence: retain according to supplier, legal and operational requirements; restrict by role.
- Nonce/replay records: retain only for the replay window plus operational margin.
- Application logs: avoid full records; retain identifiers, versions, results and sanitized codes.
- RFQ data: collect only needed business contact/order information; document retention and deletion process.
- Credentials/secrets: never store in packet, spreadsheets, source rows or logs.
- Deletion/correction: preserve audit metadata showing who authorized and when, without retaining deleted sensitive content beyond policy.
